Payout of 21 July is short ₹431.00.
The bank credited ₹1,89,166.58 against an expected ₹1,89,597.58. 20 orders sit in this payout. This is consistent with chargeback cb_00006 of ₹431.00, raised 6 August. The gateway debits a disputed amount when it receives the dispute, but books it against the cycle in which the dispute is later confirmed, so the two can fall in different payouts.
Suggested action: confirm chargeback cb_00006 against this payout and record the dispute in the books. The amounts match, which is not proof of cause -- cb_00006 is booked to another cycle, so the link is not confirmed.
